DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Pillar of Frost is active, as it amplifies their primary burst window.
  • Empower Rune Weapon is active, ensuring maximum resource generation during the haste buff.
  • Both Pillar of Frost and Empower Rune Weapon are available and ready to be synced for a stacked cooldown phase.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when encountering enemies during a single-target priority phase or when adds persist, along with one of the following:

  • Their Summon Gargoyle is active and has 22 seconds or less remaining.
  • They are using Army of the Dead (without Summon Gargoyle) with an active Abomination under 18 seconds remaining or Army Ghouls active for 18 seconds or less.
  • They have neither Summon Gargoyle nor Army of the Dead talented, and Dark Transformation is active.
  • They do not have Summon Gargoyle talented but have Dark Transformation active (regardless of other talents).
  • Summon Gargoyle is inactive, and its cooldown will not align with your next Power Infusion availability.
  • Three or more enemies are present while Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is affecting the area.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • The Demonhunter is transformed in Metamorphosis to amplify their primary burst window.
  • The fight duration is below 20 seconds remaining to ensure the buff covers the final phase.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Their major cooldowns are aligned and they do not have the Tier 31 4-piece set active.
  • They have the Tier 31 4-piece set and are triggering either a single or double Celestial Alignment phase.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Feral Druid has Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane active during Bloodlust/Heroism (via Buff Synergy).
  • The Feral Druid does not have Berserk: Heart of the Lion talented, ensuring alignment with their default cooldown windows.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Dragonrage is active and Shattering Star is on cooldown, the target has the Shattering Star debuff, or there are 2 or more enemies.
  • The encounter will end in less than 35 seconds to prevent cooldown waste.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • The Hunter’s Trueshot has more than 12 seconds remaining, ensuring maximum cooldown synergy
  • The encounter is about to end within 13 seconds, guaranteeing full Power Infusion utilization before the fight concludes
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active with over 7 seconds remaining and Power Infusion isn't active.
  • The Hunter doesn't use Coordinated Assault and Spearhead is on cooldown.
  • The Hunter has neither Coordinated Assault nor Spearhead talents.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • The Mage has just cast Arcane Surge as their previous ability
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not active, and they have Combustion active with more than 6 seconds remaining on its duration.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds, and Power Infusion hasn't been used yet.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is off cooldown and the Mage does not already have the buff active.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is active AND either Bloodlust is not active, or Bloodlust is active AND Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown.
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • They have an active Avenging Wrath buff (their primary damage cooldown)
  • They have an active Crusade buff (when using this talent instead of Avenging Wrath)
  • Their target is affected by Execution Sentence (during this debuff's damage window)
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform, Dark Ascension, or the Tier 20 4-piece set bonus is active
  • Power Infusion is not already affecting them
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Deathmark is active on their target, as this aligns with their major cooldown burst window (often paired with Vendetta) to maximize damage amplification.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They activate Shadow Dance, as this aligns with their primary burst phase and enhances their ability to chain high-damage stealth abilities.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • Their Ascendance buff is currently active, maximizing burst damage during this transformative window.
  • Ascendance’s cooldown has over 30 seconds remaining, allowing you to use Power Infusion on alternative high-priority abilities without delaying it.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • They have the Deeply Rooted Elements talent and their Ascendance buff has more than 7.5 seconds remaining.
  • They do not have Deeply Rooted Elements and have Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds active.
  • The fight will end within 20 seconds of the next 2-minute interval (e.g., 1:40-2:00 remaining).
  • All their major cooldowns have at least 120 seconds remaining before becoming available again.
  • They are not using Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds talents at all.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • Their Soul Rot is active, enhancing their drain effects and damage window.
  • They have activated major cooldowns (e.g., Darkglare, Summoner’s Pacts) to amplify burst damage phases.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Wild Imps are about to despawn within a window of 6 global cooldowns plus your current cast time, allowing maximum spell throughput before they expire.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Infernal is currently active (to synergize with their primary damage window).
  • The warlock is not talented into Summon Infernal (use cooldown freely).
  • The fight duration is shorter than the time remaining until Infernal’s next cooldown plus 15 seconds (prevows casting opportunity).
  • The encounter will end before Infernal can be reused, even with a 10-second buffer for Power Infusion’s duration.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • Colossus Smash is active on the target and the encounter duration has at least 135 seconds remaining.
  • The target is in Execute Phase (below 20% health) and Avatar is active on the Warrior.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds or less.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has more than 15 seconds remaining AND the encounter will last at least 135 more seconds
  • In the Execute phase (target below 20% health) while Avatar is active
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds (to avoid wasting the cooldown)
